Super Earth
A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to terriers 6 months and older. 1 second per foot of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached and then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty.

Nosework
To help accommodate owners entering two dogs in the same class we are offering this option: you can have someone else run the second dog or you can wait until the end of that class to allow the judge time to relocate the hide for the second dog. It will be the owner’s responsibility to check back, before the event closes, to verify the appropriate time to run their second dog.
Jack Russell Terrier Nosework
Sanctioned event, open to JRT six months and older who are capable of alerting to the target odors. Level 1 target odor is birch. Level 2 target odors will be two (2) scents only, chosen at the judge's discretion from birch, anise, and clove. A Level 1 title is not required to enter Level 2 classes.

Urban Warfare (Non-Sanctioned)
Sponsor: Seagull Kennels
Urban Warfare is a non-sanctioned event designed to assess the hunting abilities and collaborative relationship between terriers and their handlers. The event replicates realistic hunting scenarios in both urban and field environments, utilizing a combination of natural and artificial materials. Each terrier aims to accumulate the highest number of points in the shortest time possible by navigating the Urban Warfare course in pursuit of the hidden wildlife quarry.

Super Earth
A challenging GTG course with a series of false entrances and/or false tunnels and dens. Open to terriers 6 months and older. 1 second per foot of tunnel to reach quarry; may leave and re-enter earth several times until the quarry is reached and then must work quarry for one full minute without a break in work and without leaving quarry. May switch from one type of work to another without penalty.

Urban Warfare (Non-Sanctioned)
Urban Warfare is a non-sanctioned event designed to assess the hunting abilities and collaborative relationship between terriers and their handlers. The event replicates realistic hunting scenarios in both urban and field environments, utilizing a combination of natural and artificial materials. Each terrier aims to accumulate the highest number of points in the shortest time possible by navigating the Urban Warfare course in pursuit of the hidden wildlife quarry.
